text: Therefore, this study is the first to integrate Gal-3 with Th1/Th2-related cytokines (IL-2, IFN-γ, IL-4, and IL-33). Through correlation analysis, logistic regression, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, we aim to elucidate the association of these markers with the severity of anxiety and depression (including comorbidities) in COPD patients and to evaluate their combined diagnostic efficacy, thereby addressing current gaps in the literature.
source_label: Correlation analysis of serum galectin-3 combined with Th1/Th2-related cytokines and severe anxiety and depression symptoms in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
